description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-records/ (#4705) at a Träger with two
schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger transaction, its
release, the records and their links in one statement each; then per school
the binding of its tenant transaction, the employments with their profiles
and the persons behind them in three statements. Flat in the number of
people and records; one tenant transaction per school (ADR 0089 section 10,
ADR 0232).
